not_certified_claims: Step39 provides evidence-depth and analytical validation qualification inside the repository.
It is not FDA/EMA approval, clinical utility authorization, laboratory accreditation, or a sponsor wet-lab replication package.
Prospective-style entries are prediction-lock/held-out public-reference validation records, not a wet-lab trial claim unless the user imports such results.
